newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE products steady, but fuel oil offered higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE products steady, but fuel oil offered higher.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly steady on Monday as trade suffered from the absence of London players and futures screens, but fuel oil was offered higher.
High sulphur fuel oil was offered $1/$2 higher at $103 fob ARA by about six sellers, but there were no bids above $100.

Traders said sellers were cautious in case there was a repeat of Friday morning's aggressive buying. Eurograde gasoline barges were offered at $208 fob Rotterdam for running refinery material. Offers from ARA storage were at $206.
Gas oil remained offered at a premium over Sept IPE of $1 fob, or a price of $192. --Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
